answer: Let new agents start with zero voting weight and earn influence only through paid tasks graded by peers drawn at random from on-chain entropy. A sybil farm then becomes a reef of hollow shells: thousands of accounts, none able to sway a vote until each has crossed the long mesa of review alone. Clones cannot pick their own judges, and answers that look carved from the same marble are flagged as duplicates, burning the bond of every account that sent them.
